text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after heading to the track to
observe
everyone training, I bump into
Tsurumaru
Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're that trainer from before!
Thanks for
cheering me on the other
day!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've been doing my very best! And
training using
my custom-made
schedule!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sounds absolutely full of
self-confidence, but
I hope her training's
not so hard that she's driving
herself to
the point of collapse again like last
time.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind at all! Go ahead and
watch for as
long as you like!
choice_data_list: トレーニング見せてもらってもいい？
choice_data_list_en: Mind if I watch your training?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff... Pant... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I was fretting for nothing.
Tsurumaru
Tsuyoshi has mastered her
training. I don't think I
have to worry
about her collapsing as long as she

maintains this level of effort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only issue is that her training seems
quite
basic, and I'm not seeing anything
particularly
special going on.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I think I still have enough gas in
the tank
for another lap up the ramp!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her training on the turf track is

markedly more difficult.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think I should be able to go a
little faster
on my final spurt.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Okay, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After doing a few low-effort laps around
the
ramps, she switches to the turf track
and practices
going all-out in the last
stretch. She's clearly not
just dashing
about haphazardly. This is all very

calculated.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So what did you think of my custom
training
routine?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I tried working your advice into the way I
train!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
After we talked, I tried analyzing my
classmates'
training exercises really
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was getting up early every morning to
do a
bunch of research, and while I was
doing that,
something dawned on me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I'm just as fast as Spe
when I pull
off my final spurt on the last
stretch of a run!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes to lower body
strength, even
El has to work hard to
keep building hers!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: What I realized is that everyone's got strengths and weaknesses, including me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I decided to make the most of what
I've got.
I'm gonna make my strengths
even stronger and
do what I can to stop
my weaknesses from
holding me back!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And I'm gonna stick to doing my
absolute best
while following basic
training exercises that my
body can
handle!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
'Cause if I go nuts and collapse, then it's
all
pointless anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sticking to this training plan is how I'm
gonna
hold my own against my peers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only has she accepted the
constraints of her
physique—she's also
now working herself as hard
as she can
within those limits.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: R-really? Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm gonna start blushing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm gonna run a bit more before I
call it a
day. You're welcome to stay and
watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no turning down an offer like
that. I do as
she suggests and watch the
rest of her training
session.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't train with quite the same
fervor or
flashiness as Special Week or El
Condor Pasa,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done running yet! I've still got
another lap
in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That sheer positivity with which she
grapples any
kind of hardship that
comes her way... That's the
one area
where she's unrivaled.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Splutter... Pant... Ack... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Rasp... Pheeew... I think... maybe I... overdid it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi sure is a runner
worth
keeping an eye on—for more
reasons than one...
